title: Page 1
lines: 大红喜字光鲜簇新，芙蓉帐内是一团火似的新娘。
龙凤花烛喜气洋洋，新房内的气氛却跟灵堂没两样，凝重又沉肃，新娘端坐在喜床上，等候着新郎拿着秤杆挑起红盖头，由她紧掐着喜帕的玲珑小手可以看得出来她既期待又紧张。
然而新郎早在半个时辰前便进了新房，并将她的陪嫁丫鬟给赶了出去，却迟迟没有任何动作，就连新房外都没有半点热闹喧哗的欢欣气氛，为此，新娘更是紧张得动也不敢动，简直就像是尊木头雕像。
整整一个时辰过去了，就算是木头雕像也会受不住，更何况是娇滴滴的新娘子，忍不住地，她挪动了下麻木的双腿，而她这一动，坐在八仙桌前的新郎终于也动了。
衣物发出的窸窣声让她一僵，连忙再次端坐，屏息等待。
这一次新郎没让她失望，覆在绝美娇颜上的红盖头飞落，然而却不是由秤杆挑起，而是被新郎轻率的以手掀起。
但新娘并不在意，等待许久的一刻，她满心欢喜的缓缓抬起明丽的俏脸儿，羞怯水灵的眸子踌躇片刻后才对上他狭长的俊眸。
四目相望的瞬间，新娘羞怯欢喜的情绪却像是被人浇了盆冷冽的冰水，瞬间降至冰点，因为那双总是温和的俊眸里没有丝毫成亲的喜悦，只有冰冷及毫不遮掩的鄙夷。
但为什么呢？她不懂。
她咬着抹着胭脂的粉唇，怯生生的唤道：「竞天哥……」
「不要叫我！」封竞天俊颜更冷，就连嗓音都冷若寒霜，「你不配叫我的名字。」
她冷不防吓了一跳。
他对她一向有礼，虽然总是刻意的疏离，却从未像今日这般冷漠，甚至可以说是……嫌恶。
她不明所以，怀着忐忑不安的心情，试探地再次开口，「是不是我哪里做得不好，惹你气恼？」
是否是她表现得不够端庄，才会惹他生气？
她的话让他嗤笑出声，「绦岚秋，你少装了，我告诉你，我封竞天绝不是受人摆布之人，你的计谋对我无用。」
绦岚秋妆点精致的绝美脸蛋覆着浓浓的困惑，「你在说什么，我怎么一句话也听不懂……」
封竞天怒声道：「少跟我演戏，我说过，这招或许对紫嫣有用，但对我无用，像你这种心机深沉的女人，一辈子都别想当我封竞天的妻！」
他最后那句话让她娇躯一震，不解的问：「你……你在说什么？咱们不是已经成了亲？」
她愈听愈糊涂，虽然婚礼简单，邀请的宾客也不多，可他们明明才刚拜堂成亲，他怎会说她一辈子都别想成为他的妻？
「你以为我真的想娶你？」她那一副什么都不知的模样，让他心中恼怒更甚，「是我太低估你，竟没看出你的温顺是装出来的，才会愚蠢的踏进你设的局，但你不会天真的以为我会就这么认输，娶一个我不爱、甚至是唾弃的女人？」
闻言，绦岚秋心一缩，俏脸刷白。
她知道他不爱她，一直都知道，但她不在意，她以为他肯娶她，是愿意接纳她对他的感情、是对紫嫣死了心，可现在……
他眼神里浓烈的憎恨、明显的嫌恶，让她心房狠狠一痛，俏颜更白。
颤着嗓，她哑声问：「既然如此……你为何答应娶我过门？」
因为那场意外？还是……
「还装蒜？」封竞天不得不佩服她的演技，若不是他吃过她的亏，肯定会被她楚楚可怜的无辜模样所骗。「绦岚秋，你该知道我喜欢的是紫嫣。」
一提到自己的胞妹，绦岚秋美眸倏地一暗。
封竞天喜爱绦紫嫣、非她莫娶是众所皆知的事，她身为姊姊又岂会不知？然而可悲的是，她明明知道，却还是无可救药的爱上这心有所属的男人。
她自虐吗？不，她只是爱惨了他，一得知他答应娶她，便高兴得好几日睡不着觉，却从没想过他为何会答应娶她。
「紫嫣已经成亲了。」掩去眼中的痛楚，她低声说。
她亲爱的妹妹比她早了半个月出阁，婚礼盛大热闹，是全城皆知的一大喜事。
想到心爱的女人另嫁他人，封竞天俊眸闪过一抹痛楚，恼怒的说：「就算如此，我心里依然有她，至于你，一个不知羞耻爬上我的床、强逼我负责的女人，你真认为我会甘愿？」
艳红的唇早已被她咬得毫无血色，绦岚秋急忙摇头，「我没有！那是个意外！我也没有逼你，我明明不要你负……」
「别在我面前演戏！那只会让我觉得恶心！」他厌恶的低喊。
这一喊堵住了绦岚秋所有的解释，一颗心揪得死紧，痛得她几乎无法开口，可她终究还是问了。
「是谁……是谁让你答应娶我过门？」
她一再的装傻让封竞天十分不耐，隐忍多日的不悦再也忍不住爆发。
「绦岚秋，你究竟要装到何时？听好，我被你骗了一次叫傻，要是再让你骗第二次，那就是蠢，你说我可会让自己再次沦为蠢物？」他怒瞪着她那张绝美的容颜，恨声又说：「你不知羞耻的爬上我的床，嘴里说不要我负责、不会告诉任何人，一转身却跑去向紫嫣哭诉，说我坏你清白，像你这样心机深沉的女人，若不是紫嫣要我对你负责，你以为我会娶你？」
果然是紫嫣……
心房因他一字一句而阵阵抽疼着，他的憎恨让她说不出话，明白他早认定这一切都是她设下的局，根本听不进她的解释，于是她敛下眼中的酸楚，抿着粉唇，不做任何辩解。
「说不出话了？」认定她的沉默是默认，封竞天讥诮的勾起唇角，漠然道：「既然无话可说，那好，我这就告诉你，就算要我封竞天一辈子不娶，也绝不可能娶你，会和你成亲绝不是因为什么狗屁责任，而是为了报复！」
他冷冽的语气仿佛一把利刃，刀刀划向她早已遍体鳞伤的心。
「报……复？」她下意识的重复这句话。
黑眸一凛，他寒声道：「我要休妻！」
这无情的四个字如青天霹雳，足以将绦岚秋推入地狱，她禁不住浑身发颤。
果然……
紧闭双眼，她强忍着心头的痛楚，嘶哑的说：「好。」
她的干脆让封竞天诧异的挑高眉。
他不需要她的同意，但他以为她不会这么容易妥协，毕竟她处心积虑设下这么一着棋，不该如此轻易放弃。
这女人又想耍什么把戏？
「你可以休了我，但我有一个条件。」深吸口气，她努力漠然以对。
他鄙夷的看着她。「你没资格和我谈条件。」
「若是你不答应，那我们只有对簿公堂。」无视他鄙夷的眼神，她挺直腰杆，接着又说：「咱们成亲不到一日，七出之罪我一条也没犯，你如何休妻？」
「你确定？」他勾起一抹嘲讽的笑，「欲加之罪何患无辞？光是七出中的‘淫佚’，我就能将你休之！」
绦岚秋一怔。
「淫佚」是指妇女有放纵淫乱的行为，此条要求妻子对丈夫保守贞操，不得与人有染，以保持家族稳定和血统纯正，新婚夜更有着「验红」的习俗，若非处子之身，则可立即休妻。
而她，确实非处子之身。
粉拳微颤着，明知道接下来的话会让封竞天对她更加嫌恶，但为了家誉，她不得不说。「如果我将你休妻一事告诉紫嫣呢？」
一提到绦紫嫣，封竞天俊脸倏地一沉。
他要休她，她无话可说，可她绦家不能出一个出嫁不到一日便被以七出之罪休离的子孙，且还是犯了七出中的「淫佚」，别说愧对于列祖列宗，还有她的爹爹……

Chapter 1(1)
The bright red word "Happy" is bright and new, and inside the hibiscus tent is a bride like fire.
The dragons and phoenixes were filled with joy, but the atmosphere in the new house was the same as that of the mourning hall, dignified and solemn. The bride sat on the wedding bed, waiting for the groom to pick up the red hijab with the scale beam. It could be seen from her small hands holding the wedding handkerchief tightly that she was both looking forward to it and nervous.
However, the bridegroom entered the bridal chamber half an hour ago and kicked out her dowry maid, but there was still no movement. There was no lively and noisy atmosphere outside the bridal chamber. For this reason, the bride was even more nervous and did not dare to move. She was like a wooden statue.
An entire hour passed, and even a wooden statue couldn't bear it, let alone the delicate bride. She couldn't help but move her numb legs, and with her movement, the groom who was sitting in front of the Eight Immortals table finally moved too.
The rustling sound of clothes made her stiffen, and she quickly sat upright again, waiting with bated breath.
This time the groom did not disappoint her. The red hijab covering her beautiful face flew off. However, it was not lifted up by the scales, but flippantly lifted up by the groom's hands.
But the bride didn't care. After waiting for a long time, she slowly raised her bright and pretty face full of joy, and her shy and watery eyes hesitated for a moment before meeting his narrow and handsome eyes.
The moment their eyes met, the shy and joyful mood of the bride was like someone pouring a basin of cold ice water on her, instantly dropping to freezing point, because there was no joy of getting married in her always gentle handsome eyes, only coldness and undisguised disdain.
But why? She doesn't understand.
She bit her rouged pink lips and timidly called out, "Brother Jingtian..."
"Don't call me!" Feng Jingtian's handsome face was even colder, and even his voice was as cold as frost, "You don't deserve to call me by my name."
She was startled unexpectedly.
He had always been polite to her, and although he was always deliberately distant, he had never been as cold as today, and could even be said to be...disgusting.
She didn't know why, and with an uneasy mood, she tentatively spoke again, "Did I do something wrong that made you angry?"
Did she act immodestly enough to make him angry?
Her words made him laugh out loud, "Gui Lanqiu, stop pretending. I'm telling you, I, Feng Jingtian, will never be manipulated by others. Your strategies are of no use to me."
Gui Lanqiu's exquisitely beautiful face was covered with deep confusion, "What are you talking about? I can't understand a word..."
Feng Jingtian said angrily: "Stop acting with me. I told you that this trick may be useful for Zi Yan, but it is useless for me. A scheming woman like you will never want to be my wife, Feng Jingtian!"
His last words made her tremble, and she asked in confusion: "You...what are you talking about? Aren't we already married?"
The more she listened, the more confused she became. Although the wedding was simple and there were not many guests invited, they had just gotten married. How could he say that she would never want to be his wife?
"Do you think I really want to marry you?" Her clueless look made him even more angry. "I underestimated you too much and didn't realize that your meekness was fake, so I stupidly stepped into the trap you set. But you wouldn't be so naive as to think that I would just give in and marry a woman that I don't love or even despise?"
Hearing this, Gui Lanqiu's heart shrank and her pretty face turned pale.
She knew he didn't love her, she had always known it, but she didn't care. She thought he was willing to marry her because he was willing to accept her feelings for him and because he had given up on Zi Yan, but now...
The strong hatred and obvious disgust in his eyes made her heart ache, and her pretty face became even whiter.
With a trembling voice, she asked hoarsely: "In that case...why did you agree to marry me?"
Because of the accident? Or...
"Still pretending?" Feng Jingtian had to admire her acting skills. If he hadn't suffered from her, he would have been deceived by her pitiful and innocent appearance. "Qi Lanqiu, you should know that I like Zi Yan."
At the mention of her sister, Sui Lanqiu's beautiful eyes dimmed suddenly.
It is known to everyone that Feng Jingtian loves Sui Ziyan and would marry her. How could she not know this as her sister? However, the sad thing is that even though she knew it, she still fell hopelessly in love with this man who had her heart set on her.
Does she abuse herself? No, she just loved him terribly. As soon as she learned that he agreed to marry her, she was so happy that she couldn't sleep for several days, but she never thought about why he agreed to marry her.
"Zi Yan is married." She whispered, covering up the pain in her eyes.
Her dear sister left the court half a month earlier than she did. The wedding was grand and lively, and it was a happy event known to the whole city.
Thinking of the woman he loved marrying another man, Feng Jingtian's handsome eyes flashed with pain, and he said angrily: "Even so, I still have her in my heart. As for you, a woman who shamelessly climbed into my bed and forced me to take responsibility, do you really think I will be willing to do so?"
Her bright red lips had long been bitten by her and turned bloodless. Guan Lanqiu hurriedly shook her head, "I didn't! It was an accident! I didn't force you, I clearly don't want you to take the blame..."
"Don't act in front of me! It just makes me feel sick!" he shouted in disgust.
This shout blocked all explanations from Guan Lanqiu. Her heart was so tightly clenched that she could hardly speak in pain, but she still asked after all.
"Who... who made you agree to marry me?"
Her repeated pretending to be stupid made Feng Jingtian very impatient, and the displeasure he had held in for many days could no longer be suppressed.
"Qi Lanqiu, how long are you going to keep pretending? Listen, I was fooled by you once, and I am stupid if I let you fool me a second time. Do you think I will let myself become a fool again?" He glared at her beautiful face, and said hatefully: "You don't You crawled onto my bed in shame, saying that you didn't want me to be responsible, and that you wouldn't tell anyone. Then you turned around and ran to cry to Zi Yan, saying that I ruined your innocence. For such a scheming woman like you, if Zi Yan hadn't asked me to be responsible for you, do you think I would have married you?"
It is indeed Zi Yan...
Her heart throbbed with pain because of his every word, and his hatred made her speechless. She understood that he had long believed that all of this was set up by her, and could not listen to her explanation at all, so she suppressed the sadness in her eyes, pursed her pink lips, and did not make any excuses.
"Are you speechless?" Convinced that her silence was acquiescence, Feng Jingtian raised the corners of his lips sarcastically and said indifferently: "Since I have nothing to say, fine, I'll tell you right now, even if I, Feng Jingtian, are asked not to marry for the rest of my life, I will never marry you. I will marry you not because of any bullshit responsibility, but for revenge!"
His cold tone was like a sharp blade, cutting into her already bruised heart.
"Retaliation?" She repeated this sentence subconsciously.
His dark eyes flashed, and he said coldly: "I want to divorce my wife!"
These four ruthless words were like a thunderbolt from the blue sky, enough to push Gui Lanqiu into hell. She couldn't help but tremble all over.
Sure enough...
She closed her eyes tightly, resisting the pain in her heart, and said hoarsely: "Okay."
Her straightforwardness made Feng Jingtian raise his eyebrows in surprise.
He didn't need her consent, but he thought she wouldn't compromise so easily. After all, she had deliberately set up such a move and shouldn't give up so easily.
What trick is this woman trying to play?
"You can divorce me, but I have a condition." She took a deep breath and tried to be indifferent.
He looked at her with disdain. "You are not qualified to negotiate terms with me."
"If you don't agree, then we will have no choice but to go to court." Ignoring his contemptuous look, she straightened her back and continued, "We have been married for less than a day, and I haven't committed any of the seven sins. How can you divorce your wife?"
"Are you sure?" He asked with a sarcastic smile, "Why bother trying to incriminate yourself? I can put you to death just for the 'obscenity' among the seven acts!"
Qi Lanqiu was startled.
"Fornication" refers to a woman's indulgent and promiscuous behavior. This article requires the wife to maintain her chastity to her husband and not have any affairs with others in order to maintain the stability of the family and the purity of the bloodline. There is also the custom of "testing for redness" on the wedding night. If she is not a virgin, she can be divorced immediately.
And she was indeed not a virgin.
Pink Fist trembled slightly, knowing that the next words would make Feng Jingtian hate her even more, but for the sake of family honor, she had to say it. "What if I tell Zi Yan about your divorce?"
At the mention of Sui Ziyan, Feng Jingtian's handsome face suddenly sank.
He wanted to divorce her, but she had nothing to say, but her family could not have a descendant who was divorced less than a day after getting married for the crime of seven marriages, and still committed "fornication" among the seven marriages. Not to mention that she was ashamed of her ancestors, and her father...
